moduleDescription: Shared error type for the Genzimnify toolchain. Errors are "cap". Reporting them is "calling cap".

entries.name: GzimError
entries.code:
GzimError = ref object of CatchableError
  line*: int
  col*: int

entries.name: newGzimError
entries.code:
proc newGzimError(msg: string; line = 0; col = 0): GzimError {.raises: [],
    tags: [], forbids: [].}
